available_target_level: EU regional sector proxy and collective economy-wide NDC
observed_inputs: certified WLTP tailpipe intensity where reported
certified WLTP electricity consumption where reported
publication_reason: Every destination-use, energy, and policy-pathway input resolved to a sourced value with a tier. The result covers 96.9% of the cohort's units; the remainder is withheld by product type rather than assumed. The result is a destination-cohort impact, not an export claim: registrations are not mapped to production origin.

FCEV.reason: FCEV needs a hydrogen supply emissions intensity for the destination market.

PHEV.reason: PHEV needs the charge-depleting and charge-sustaining split and a real-world utility factor. The registration dataset publishes only the weighted combined values, so no utility factor can be recovered without assuming one.
